title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous penalties’ for US tech firms that build datacenters abroad
summary_full: President gives wide-ranging White House press conference and says he has ‘fantastic relationships’ with Putin and XiDonald Trump threatened on Friday to impose “tremendous penalties” on American tech companies that build datacenters outside the US, though he gave no details and told reporters he had not yet informed his own officials about the plan.In a discursive press conference from the White House briefing room, Trump also said he would “look into” the report that Iran had been planning to possibly detonate a “dirty bomb” in Washington DC, and backed JD Vance over comments the vice-president made blaming Republican midterm losses on the Iran war.
